definitions.gloss: see you later; bye then; well then, goodbye
definitions.explanation: A casual parting greeting used among friends, family, and peers. Implies the expectation of meeting again.

examples.japanese: じゃあまた{明日|あした}。
じゃあまたね。{気|き}をつけてね。
{楽|たの}しかったよ。じゃあまた{今度|こんど}{遊|あそ}ぼう。
examples.english: That was fun. Well then, let's hang out again sometime.

notes:
A very common informal goodbye. Composed of じゃあ ('well then') and また ('again'). Often followed by a time expression: じゃあまた{明日|あした} ('see you tomorrow'), じゃあまた{来週|らいしゅう} ('see you next week'). Adding ね at the end (じゃあまたね) makes it softer and more friendly.

FORMS:
- じゃあまたね: see you later (softer, friendlier)
- じゃあね: bye then (shorter, very casual)
- ではまた: see you later (slightly more formal)
- じゃ、また: same meaning, sometimes written with a comma

SIMILAR WORDS:
- またね: see you — even more casual shortening
- さようなら: goodbye — formal; carries a more final, distant nuance
- バイバイ: bye-bye — very casual, often used by younger speakers
- お{疲|つか}れさまでした: good work / goodbye — used when leaving a workplace
